name: Software quality

subjectOf.text: Modern code review imposes substantial hidden costs because developers spend an average of six hours per week reviewing others' changes and are forced to switch away from their own work, creating an opportunity cost on project development.
subjectOf.abstract: Developers spend a significant amount of time reviewing the changes of others – an average of 6 hours per week.11 Not only is this a significant amount of time, it also requires an opportunity cost on project development as developers are forced to switch away from their current work.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: modern code review in industry and open source settings

subjectOf.text: Organizational metrics, such as the number of developers working on a component, organizational distance between developers, and organizational code ownership, are better predictors of defect proneness than traditional metrics like churn, complexity, coverage, dependencies, and pre release bug measures.
